subject: Vendor onboarding: bridge PO issuance and line-item normalization
messages:
From: Sasha Turner <sasha.turner@procureco.com>
To: Grace Occonnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding docs + PO issuance question

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. Attaching our completed onboarding form and W-9 for ProcureCo. We are trying to reconcile the initial PO you mentioned in the call with the line items we uploaded to your onboarding portal — several SKUs were split during our ERP export and appear as duplicate lines in your system.

Two quick asks:
- Can you confirm when the provisional PO number for our account will be created? We need that to start invoicing.
- Our onboarding sheet shows a spend cap of $40,000 but the contract we signed referenced a $50k trial cap. Which figure will be applied to the provisional PO?

I attached the onboarding_form and W9. Also included a small sample CSV export that shows the duplicate lines (PO-lines_export_sample.csv). Happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Sasha Turner
Vendor Operations
ProcureCo
attachments: ProcureCo_Onboarding_Form.pdf (pdf), W9_ProcureCo.pdf (pdf), PO-lines_export_sample.csv (csv)
From: Grace Occonnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Turner <sasha.turner@procureco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding docs + PO issuance question

Hi Sasha —

Thanks for sending everything. I pulled the files into the vendor onboarding queue and looked at the sample CSV. You’re right: two SKU rows look like an ERP split (same part number, different line codes). Before I ask procurement to issue a provisional PO, could you do the following so we can keep the ledger clean?

Action items for ProcureCo (please):
1) Update the CSV so the duplicate ERP-split rows are merged into a single line with a combined quantity and one unit price (you can preserve the original split rows in an "erp_note" column).
2) Confirm which spend cap should apply: the signed contract copy or the onboarding portal number. If the contract says $50,000 we need a copy attached.
3) Indicate if any of the line items are tax-exempt or should be routed through a different cost center (this affects our internal ledger mapping).

I’m looping in Ben (procurement) and Priyom (billing) to help with PO issuance and final cap reconciliation.

If you can get the corrected CSV back by EOD Pacific we’ll aim to hand this to procurement tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Grace
Sr. Manager, Vendor Onboarding
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace Occonnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Sasha Turner <sasha.turner@procureco.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 13:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding docs + PO issuance question

Grace / Sasha —

I reviewed the onboarding packet and the sample lines. Procurement is comfortable issuing a provisional PO once we receive the cleaned CSV and confirmation on the cap. Tentative details:
- Provisional PO: PO-2026-RW-01572 (will be finalized after the cleaned upload)
- Temporary spend cap applied to provisional PO: $50,000 (percontract confirmation)
- If ProcureCo confirms some lines are tax-exempt, we’ll map those to cost center 4302 and exclude sales tax allocation.

I uploaded a short authorization token to our procurement tracker in case you need to kick off invoice routing: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/attachment/po_auth_01572.txt (text file with next steps)

Priyom — can you confirm whether we need a separate billing alias for ProcureCo to reflect the two ledger buckets?

Ben Carter
Senior Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference
attachments: po_authorization_link.txt (text)
From: Sasha Turner <sasha.turner@procureco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace Occonnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureCo Finance <acctspayable@procureco.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding docs + PO issuance question

Ben / Grace —

Thanks — we updated the CSV and merged the ERP-split rows per Grace's instructions (attached PO-lines_v2.csv). Contract copy confirming $50,000 cap attached as well. None of the items are tax-exempt.

Quick confirmation: we see the provisional PO number in Ben's note (PO-2026-RW-01572) — please confirm when that will appear in your vendor portal so our finance team can route the first invoices. If you can provide the expected activation time (date/time) that would help avoid invoice rejections.

Happy to hop on a quick 15-minute sync if that speeds things up.

Best,
Sasha Turner
Vendor Operations
ProcureCo
attachments: PO-lines_v2.csv (csv), Signed_Contract_ProcureCo_50k.pdf (pdf)
